hypotheses.finding: Fresh corrected discovery shows regime-dependent procedure/local effects and frequent local-override population costs, but four seeds per cell and aliased L9 interactions do not identify a unique continuous optimum.

Corrected selected vectors have small regime-dependent contrasts against ordinary social learning. The final execution-priced bounded planner has fresh matched costs/counts but does not beat ordinary in its three sentinels. These algorithm-class comparisons do not establish a distinct authority advantage over general learning.

The final fixed-proposition assay uses actual training, cloned adult states and static/switching priors. Information-equalized d changes no factual posterior; H can differ through reinforcement. Prior inertia is not identified as irrational dogmatism or obligation.
No institutional teaching-access/evaluator bundle was implemented.
Corrected ecology and paired T=80 descendants can describe regime-dependent finite outcomes; no attractor, direct competition, rare-mutant exponent, or asymptotic selection assay ran.
B/K/T/H are exported separately, adult direct override is off, and corrected asocial sentinels are estimable; ecological competence-independence was not identified.

The final execution-priced bounded EVI comparator fixes marginal costs, observes actual remaining time and retains world-level purchase counts, but remains a one-decision algorithm under common Q0. No global-planner/general-RL equivalence or specialized-adaptation result is established.

R4 now executes the independent/copied by visible/hidden-provenance cognitive factorial with acquired tutor histories and exact likelihood enumeration. Ecological cross-root attribution and a provenance-saturation fitness experiment remain untested.
